name: pretty-formatter
description: Safe Twig and HTML formatting, with bundled Prettier for JavaScript, TypeScript, CSS, JSON, XML and Liquid.

pretty-formatter.disableLanguages.description: A list of languages IDs to disable this extension on

pretty-formatter.ignore.markdownDescription: A list of glob patterns for files that should never be formatted, similar to a `.prettierignore` file. Patterns are matched against the workspace-relative path, the absolute path, and the file name. Supports `*`, `**`, and `?`. Examples: `*.min.js`, `dist/**`, `src/generated/**/*.ts`, `vendor`.

pretty-formatter.braceLine.description: If true an empty line will be inserted after opening curly braces and before closing curly braces.
pretty-formatter.braceLine.deprecationMessage: Unused since 0.3.0. PrettyDiff has been replaced with bundled parsers. See README for supported options.

pretty-formatter.bracePadding.description: Inserts a space after the start of a container and before the end of the container if the contents of that container are not indented; such as: conditions, function arguments, and escaped sequences of template strings.
pretty-formatter.bracePadding.deprecationMessage: Unused since 0.3.0. PrettyDiff has been replaced with bundled parsers. See README for supported options.

pretty-formatter.braceStyle.description: Emulates JSBeautify's brace_style option using existing Pretty Diff options.
pretty-formatter.braceStyle.deprecationMessage: Unused since 0.3.0. PrettyDiff has been replaced with bundled parsers. See README for supported options.

pretty-formatter.braces.description: Determines if opening curly braces will exist on the same line as their condition or be forced onto a new line.
pretty-formatter.braces.deprecationMessage: Unused since 0.3.0. PrettyDiff has been replaced with bundled parsers. See README for supported options.

pretty-formatter.commentLine.description: If a blank new line should be forced above comments.
pretty-formatter.commentLine.deprecationMessage: Unused since 0.3.0. PrettyDiff has been replaced with bundled parsers. See README for supported options.

pretty-formatter.comments.description: This will determine whether comments should always start at position 0 of each line or if comments should be indented according to the code.
pretty-formatter.comments.deprecationMessage: Unused since 0.3.0. PrettyDiff has been replaced with bundled parsers. See README for supported options.

pretty-formatter.compressedCss.description: If CSS should be beautified in a style where the properties and values are minifed for faster reading of selectors.
pretty-formatter.compressedCss.deprecationMessage: Unused since 0.3.0. PrettyDiff has been replaced with bundled parsers. See README for supported options.

pretty-formatter.correct.description: Automatically correct some sloppiness in code.
pretty-formatter.correct.deprecationMessage: Unused since 0.3.0. PrettyDiff has been replaced with bundled parsers. See README for supported options.

pretty-formatter.cssInsertLines.description: Inserts new line characters between every CSS code block.
pretty-formatter.cssInsertLines.deprecationMessage: Unused since 0.3.0. PrettyDiff has been replaced with bundled parsers. See README for supported options.

pretty-formatter.elseLine.description: If else_line is true then the keyword 'else' is forced onto a new line.
pretty-formatter.elseLine.deprecationMessage: Unused since 0.3.0. PrettyDiff has been replaced with bundled parsers. See README for supported options.

pretty-formatter.endComma.description: If there should be a trailing comma in arrays and objects. Value multiline only applies to modes beautify and diff.

pretty-formatter.forceAttribute.description: If all markup attributes should be indented each onto their own line.

pretty-formatter.forceIndent.description: Will force indentation upon all content and tags without regard for the creation of new text nodes.
pretty-formatter.forceIndent.deprecationMessage: Unused since 0.3.0. PrettyDiff has been replaced with bundled parsers. See README for supported options.

pretty-formatter.formatArray.description: Determines if all array indexes should be indented, never indented, or left to the default.
pretty-formatter.formatArray.deprecationMessage: Unused since 0.3.0. PrettyDiff has been replaced with bundled parsers. See README for supported options.

pretty-formatter.formatObject.description: Determines if all object keys should be indented, never indented, or left to the default.
pretty-formatter.formatObject.deprecationMessage: Unused since 0.3.0. PrettyDiff has been replaced with bundled parsers. See README for supported options.

pretty-formatter.functionName.description: If a space should follow a JavaScript function name.
pretty-formatter.functionName.deprecationMessage: Unused since 0.3.0. PrettyDiff has been replaced with bundled parsers. See README for supported options.

pretty-formatter.indentLevel.description: How much indentation padding should be applied to beautification? This option is internally used for code that requires switching between libraries.
pretty-formatter.indentLevel.deprecationMessage: Unused since 0.3.0. PrettyDiff has been replaced with bundled parsers. See README for supported options.

pretty-formatter.indentSize.description: Indent width. 0 uses the current editor document options, including tabs.

pretty-formatter.methodChain.description: When to break consecutively chained methods and properties onto separate lines. A negative value disables this option. A value of 0 ensures method chains are never broken.
pretty-formatter.methodChain.deprecationMessage: Unused since 0.3.0. PrettyDiff has been replaced with bundled parsers. See README for supported options.

pretty-formatter.neverFlatten.description: If destructured lists in script should never be flattend.
pretty-formatter.neverFlatten.deprecationMessage: Unused since 0.3.0. PrettyDiff has been replaced with bundled parsers. See README for supported options.

pretty-formatter.newLine.description: Insert an empty line at the end of output.

pretty-formatter.noCaseIndent.description: If a case statement should receive the same indentation as the containing switch block.
pretty-formatter.noCaseIndent.deprecationMessage: Unused since 0.3.0. PrettyDiff has been replaced with bundled parsers. See README for supported options.

pretty-formatter.noLeadZero.description: Whether leading 0s in CSS values immediately preceeding a decimal should be removed or prevented.
pretty-formatter.noLeadZero.deprecationMessage: Unused since 0.3.0. PrettyDiff has been replaced with bundled parsers. See README for supported options.

pretty-formatter.objectSort.description: Sorts markup attributes and properties by key name in script and style.
pretty-formatter.objectSort.deprecationMessage: Unused since 0.3.0. PrettyDiff has been replaced with bundled parsers. See README for supported options.

pretty-formatter.preserve.description: The maximum number of consecutive empty lines to retain.
pretty-formatter.preserve.deprecationMessage: Unused since 0.3.0. PrettyDiff has been replaced with bundled parsers. See README for supported options.

pretty-formatter.preserveComment.description: Prevent comment reformatting due to option wrap.
pretty-formatter.preserveComment.deprecationMessage: Unused since 0.3.0. PrettyDiff has been replaced with bundled parsers. See README for supported options.

pretty-formatter.quoteConvert.description: If the quotes of script strings or markup attributes should be converted to single quotes or double quotes.

pretty-formatter.space.description: Inserts a space following the function keyword for anonymous functions.
pretty-formatter.space.deprecationMessage: Unused since 0.3.0. PrettyDiff has been replaced with bundled parsers. See README for supported options.

pretty-formatter.spaceClose.description: Markup self-closing tags end will end with ' />' instead of '/>'.

pretty-formatter.styleguide.description: Markup self-closing tags end will end with ' />' instead of '/>'.
pretty-formatter.styleguide.deprecationMessage: Unused since 0.3.0. PrettyDiff has been replaced with bundled parsers. See README for supported options.

pretty-formatter.tagMerge.description: Allows immediately adjacement start and end markup tags of the same name to be combined into a single self-closing tag.
pretty-formatter.tagMerge.deprecationMessage: Unused since 0.3.0. PrettyDiff has been replaced with bundled parsers. See README for supported options.

pretty-formatter.tagSort.description: Sort child items of each respective markup parent element.
pretty-formatter.tagSort.deprecationMessage: Unused since 0.3.0. PrettyDiff has been replaced with bundled parsers. See README for supported options.

pretty-formatter.ternaryLine.description: If ternary operators in JavaScript ? and : should remain on the same line.
pretty-formatter.ternaryLine.deprecationMessage: Unused since 0.3.0. PrettyDiff has been replaced with bundled parsers. See README for supported options.

pretty-formatter.unformatted.description: If markup tags should have their insides preserved. This option is only available to markup and does not support child tokens that require a different lexer.
pretty-formatter.unformatted.deprecationMessage: Unused since 0.3.0. PrettyDiff has been replaced with bundled parsers. See README for supported options.

pretty-formatter.variableList.description: If consecutive JavaScript variables should be merged into a comma separated list or if variables in a list should be separated.
pretty-formatter.variableList.deprecationMessage: Unused since 0.3.0. PrettyDiff has been replaced with bundled parsers. See README for supported options.

pretty-formatter.vertical.description: If lists of assignments and properties should be vertically aligned. This option is not used with the markup lexer.
pretty-formatter.vertical.deprecationMessage: Unused since 0.3.0. PrettyDiff has been replaced with bundled parsers. See README for supported options.

pretty-formatter.wrap.description: Preferred print width. 0 uses 80 for Prettier and preserves Twig/HTML attribute wrapping.

pretty-formatter.formatTimeout.description: Maximum formatting time in milliseconds. A timeout leaves the source unchanged.

pretty-formatter.embeddedFormatting.description: Format safe embedded JavaScript and CSS in Twig/HTML.
